title: Wacky Wilds
description: A Mod that adds random essential items based on irl and/or video game inspired elements to Minecraft! Think you can spot all the references?
body:
![The alternate logo of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ee3c179f7cec7a11e6ea8a1f9c4dcee22c0c73f.png)
# Find any update news on my [BlueSky](https://bsky.app/profile/blitzmouse.bsky.social)


Wacky Wilds is a mod that aims to add many aspects from either random video games, inspired from other video games, or something from a real world aspect that i'd like to see in minecraft! Whether that be harvesting cacti for fruit or blowing explosive bubbles at mobs, the craziness is what this mod aims to do!

For now, i'll list a couple of the new things i have in this mod, some personal favorites of mine anyway

## Tree Types

Palmtrees and Sandbox trees are in the game, and spawn in varying degrees and types. 

![The sandbox tree sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea0c396c6c84a1c9f0b39ed90fc7dfe18b59f5d0.png) ![the palmtree sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78336b016bcee0f12258918a69ea12b09dc805dc.png)

The Sandbox trees are very poisonous to touch, and be careful when breaking the leaves, it could drop something very dangerous. Typically found in Jungles and Sparce Jungles

Palmtrees are simple, yet few can be found depending on where you find them. Typically found in Beaches, Snowy beaches, and Deserts. 

## Items

Wouldnt be a Minecraft mod without a bunch of silly items, and this mod has quite a few of them. Some of these are simple and easy to craft, some things can take a bit of a challenge to gather the resources for. 

### Bubbles

![Bubbles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07dd61ce5cba7f6309cf5fd6b5e1bedff8ac765c.png)

Bubbles are a part of the mod, and though only a few solutions are available, they do have a chance at being useful when fighting mobs. The types are:

- Normal: Just hits the mobs kinda hard
- Bubbles of Poison: Poisons the Mob
- Bubbles of Explosion: Explodes upon impact
- Bubbles of Burning: Sets the mob on fire
- Bubbles of Levitation: Levitates Mobs
- Bubbles of Slowness: Slows down the mob
- Bubbles of Chivalry: Gives the player golden apple effects while giving weakening effects to the mob

### Revolver

![Revolver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0eb495fe418817a61c007c3e41ba89aa9484a09a.png)

yes. a loaded gun. Just as long as you have enough copper bullets, this will be a very handy ranged weapon to have.
 

Thank you for checking the mod out!
